messages.subject_clean: [rkward-users] [rkward:discussion] rkward 0.61 R 3.0.0RC bundle win32 - can't list demo datasets
messages.body_plain:
I am new to R and installed the RKWard 0.61 R 3.0.0RC win32 bundle. RKWard runs and generally works (afaikt), however, I can not list the demo datasets. E.g. when I enter...

library(MASS)
data()

package:MASS shows up in the workspace, but data() results in error...

Error in pager(files, header = header, title = title, delete.file = delete.file) : 
  unused arguments (header = header, delete.file = delete.file) 

If I try the same from RGui.exe or from RStudio it works. Also, the error is independent of OS, appearing exactly the same on WinXP SP3 and Win7 Pro x64, all users with admin rights.

Any help would be much appreciated.

messages.body_plain:
Hi!

True. This is already fixed in our development version. As a workaround in RKWard 0.6.1, run the following R code:

~~~~
options (pager=function (file = file, header = file, title = NULL, delete.file = FALSE, 
    prompt = TRUE, delete = delete.file) 
{
    invisible(.Call("rk.show.files", as.character(file), as.character(header), 
        as.character(title), delete, isTRUE(prompt), PACKAGE = "(embedding)"))
})
~~~~

You can paste this into "Settings->Configure RKWard->R Backend->Further (option) commands to run in each session", in order to make it permanent.

Regards
Thomas

messages.body_plain:
Hi!

On Sunday 25 August 2013 08:31:21 luc.bianchi wrote:
> The question is, I would like to know if it is possible to have the graphics
> window always visible in the application window like the Workspace Browser,
> the Editor, the File Browser, and the RConsole (like in R-Studio).
> 
> The only similar solution I've found is to have the graphics window fixed on
> top of all the applications windows, but this not exactly what I need.

I'm not quite sure, whether this is what you mean by "fixed on top of all the 
application windows", but to make sure you are aware of the option: You can 
"attach" graphics windows using Window->Attach. This will put the window in 
the central document area (where script files, data editors, output window go 
by default).

Eventually, we'll add the option to collect graphics windows in a tool area 
(like in R-Studio), but this is not currently possible.

Regards
Thomas
